description: This file declares external functions related to PKI entity creation, focusing on generating key pairs, certificate requests, and self-signed certificates. It serves as an interface for PKI-related operations provided by the library.

methods.name: AnscCreateAdvancedPKIEntity
methods.description: Creates a new PKI entity responsible for key generation and certificate requests, requiring context and attribute handles.

methods.name: AnscCreateAdvancedPKIEntityWithCert
methods.description: Creates a PKI entity using provided certificate data and private key encoding, along with context and attribute handles.
